profile_text.body:
Founders Fund describes itself as a San Francisco based venture capital firm investing in companies building revolutionary technologies. Its site carries a copyright notice covering 2005 to 2026 and states that Founders Fund is a registered trademark of Founders Fund, LLC. The site also carries standard investment disclaimers: that past performance is not indicative of future results, that investments may lose value, and that nothing on it is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities.

The firm is a for-profit organization founded in 2005 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. No AI products and no MCP servers are tracked for it, so it appears here as an investor rather than a vendor of AI tools. No lawsuits are tracked. Its law exposure is listed in California, with a count of 237.
